observations: Three photos show a single car headlight assembly resting on a dirt ground, partially wrapped in clear plastic.
The headlight has a modern design with a clear lens, a black housing, and an amber turn signal section on the outer edge.
The shape is angular and narrow, typical of a left-side headlight for a front-wheel-drive vehicle.
Photo 0 shows the headlight from a front-top angle, with a hand holding a phone visible in the lower left corner.
Photo 1 and 2 are similar, showing the headlight from a slightly different top angle, with handwritten markings '475' visible on the top surface of the housing.
No visible brand or model markings are readable on the headlight itself in any photo.
The watermark 'A1 MERCEDES GLOBAL' is present on all photos, but this is not on the item itself and cannot be trusted as proof of brand or model.
The seller's text says 'GLA tokumbo headlight left side', which suggests a Mercedes-Benz GLA model, but 'tokumbo' is not a standard term and may be a local or misspelled reference.
